description: For more than 35 years, Garmin Ltd. and its subsidiaries have pioneered new products, many of which feature location technology such as Global Positioning System, services and applications designed for people who live an active lifestyle. Garmin serves five primary markets, fitness, outdoor, aviation, marine and auto OEM, and designs, develops, manufactures, markets and distributes a diverse family of GPS-enabled products and other navigation, communications, sensor-based and information products and services for these markets, as well as products installed by original equipment manufacturers and for aftermarket applications. Since the inception of its business it has delivered over 300 million products, which included more than 20 million products delivered during fiscal 2025, and it offers a wide range of GPS-enabled smartwatch devices, fashion-forward hybrid smartwatches with analog style displays, and activity tracking fitness bands.
